canonical_name: Indirect self-tuning regulator (Astrom & Wittenmark, Adaptive Control ch. 3): RLS with forgetting factor estimates the plant online, pole-placement (R,S,T) recomputed every step -- a MATLAB implementation, run under Octave
lineage: The self-tuning regulator (Astrom & Wittenmark 1973; textbook Adaptive Control 1989/1995, Example 3.5-style: model-following with zero cancellation): a recursive-least-squares estimator with forgetting tracks the plant's a1,a2,b0,b1; the controller polynomials R,S,T are re-derived from the estimates each sample so the closed loop follows the reference model Am/Bm. This is a student's faithful implementation of the textbook algorithm (MATLAB, 2020) with the true plant's parameters drawn as reference lines -- the ORACLE the estimates converge to (a1=-1.6065, a2=0.6065, b0=0.1065, b1=0.0902).

source_identity.textbook: Astrom & Wittenmark, Adaptive Control, 2nd ed., ch. 3

compiler_or_interpreter: GNU Octave 7.3 (docker prometheus-fossil-octave:bookworm); plot calls shadowed by harness no-ops
entry_points: main_code.m (the loop: RLS update -> R,S,T -> control law -> plant step); rls_forgetting.m

example.input: square-wave reference uc, unknown plant simulated inside the script
example.output: theta converging to the true plant (the dashed reference lines in the script); u and y traces

upstream_docs: Astrom & Wittenmark, On self-tuning regulators, Automatica 1973
Astrom & Wittenmark, Adaptive Control, Addison-Wesley 1995, ch. 3

human_capability_summary.built_to: control a plant whose parameters are unknown by identifying them online and redesigning the controller at every step
human_capability_summary.pressure: unknown/drifting plant, the need for the closed loop to match a specified reference model
human_capability_summary.success_means: the estimated parameters converge to the plant's and the output follows the reference model

known_human_problem_solved: adaptive pole-placement control of an unknown plant
human_environmental_pressure: parameter uncertainty; excitation must be rich enough for identification
human_failure_condition: estimator divergence or controller bursting when excitation vanishes (the known STR hazard)
behavioral_entry_point: the forgetting factor lambda (0.8 in the script) and the initial covariance p: the adaptation speed knob

lineage_relations.note: RLS identification is the estimator inside this controller
